Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Schwartz Investment Counsel Has Cut Laboratory Amer Hldgs (LH) Position by $4.05 Million as Share Price Declined; United States Steel & Carnegie Pension Fund Holding in British American Tobacco (BTI) Has Boosted by $25.24 Million as Valuation Rose 
March 8, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
United States Steel & Carnegie Pension Fund increased its stake in British American Tobacco (BTI) by 87.19% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. United States Steel & Carnegie Pension Fund bought 407,062 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 873,915 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $54.58M, up from 466,853 at the end of the previous reported quarter. United States Steel & Carnegie Pension Fund who had been investing in British American Tobacco for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $134.16B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.17% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $58.51. About 1.25 million shares traded. British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSEMKT:BTI) has risen 17.78% since March 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.08% the S&P500. 
Schwartz Investment Counsel Inc decreased its stake in Laboratory Corp Amer Hldgs (LH) by 17.31% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Schwartz Investment Counsel Inc sold 27,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.17% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 129,000 shares of the medical specialities company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $19.48M, down from 156,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Schwartz Investment Counsel Inc who had been investing in Laboratory Corp Amer Hldgs for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $17.47B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.74% or $1.27 during the last trading session, reaching $171.45. About 894,553 shares traded or 43.56% up from the average. Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (NYSE:LH) has risen 10.51% since March 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.19% the S&P500. 
Among 7 analysts covering British Amrcn Tobacco ( NYSEMKT:BTI ), 5 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 71% are positive. British Amrcn Tobacco had 9 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Tuesday, August 4. The rating was upgraded by Investec to “Buy” on Friday, August 4. Morgan Stanley upgraded the shares of BTI in report on Wednesday, November 2 to “Overweight” rating. As per Friday, October 28, the company rating was upgraded by Societe Generale. The stock of British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSE:BTI) has “Sell” rating given on Thursday, December 10 by Goldman Sachs. The rating was upgraded by Investec to “Buy” on Thursday, September 8. The stock of British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSE:BTI) earned “Hold” rating by Societe Generale on Friday, July 29. The rating was initiated by Piper Jaffray on Thursday, May 25 with “Overweight”. The rating was initiated by Cowen & Co with “Market Perform” on Tuesday, August 25. 
United States Steel & Carnegie Pension Fund, which manages about $2.19 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Wells Fargo & Co (NYSE:WFC) by 500,000 shares to 682,206 shares, valued at $37.62 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 75,000 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 463,256 shares, and cut its stake in Wyndham Worldwide Corp (NYSE:WYN). 
Schwartz Investment Counsel Inc, which manages about $1.74B and $1.60 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Medtronic Plc (NYSE:MDT) by 10,000 shares to 533,907 shares, valued at $41.52 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Fastenal Co (NASDAQ:FAST) by 10,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 70,000 shares, and has risen its stake in Discover Finl Svcs (NYSE:DFS). 
Since October 30, 2017, it had 0 insider purchases, and 4 insider sales for $2.32 million activity. Shares for $213,813 were sold by Schechter Adam H. ANDERSON KERRII B also sold $548,124 worth of Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (NYSE:LH) shares. Gilliland Dwight Gary had sold 971 shares worth $149,068. 
Among 19 analysts covering Laboratory Corp ( NYSE:LH ), 12 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 63% are positive. Laboratory Corp had 62 analyst reports since July 29, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Outperform” rating on Thursday, March 1 by Credit Suisse. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, October 26 by Craig Hallum. Jefferies maintained Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (NYSE:LH) on Friday, November 24 with “Hold” rating. Jefferies maintained Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (NYSE:LH) on Tuesday, April 26 with “Hold” rating. Robert W. Baird downgraded it to “Neutral” rating and $138 target in Monday, February 6 report. On Wednesday, January 24 the stock rating was maintained by Mizuho with “Hold”. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Mizuho on Friday, February 17. Canaccord Genuity maintained Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (NYSE:LH) on Monday, September 11 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, January 29 by Goldman Sachs. The rating was maintained by UBS on Tuesday, April 26 with “Neutral”. 
Analysts await Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (NYSE:LH) to report earnings on April, 24. They expect $2.61 EPS, up 17.57% or $0.39 from last year’s $2.22 per share. LH’s profit will be $265.96M for 16.42 P/E if the $2.61 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.45 actual EPS reported by Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 6.53% EPS growth.   Ellis Scott
